tweetText: AI is being used to alleviate the strain on the UK's NHS as it faces a record 7.25 million waiting list. This innovation could help improve patient care and efficiency in a struggling healthcare system. via AI News

OpenAI has launched GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5-Cyber to enhance Trusted Access for Cyber, aiding security experts in vulnerability research. This upgrade is crucial for safeguarding essential infrastructure against cyber threats. via OpenAI News

Parloa uses OpenAI models to create advanced voice-driven AI customer service agents that can interact with customers in real-time. This innovation helps businesses improve customer support efficiency and satisfaction. via OpenAI News

OpenAI is launching new realtime voice models in their API that can reason, translate, and transcribe speech. This enhances natural voice interactions, making AI communication smarter and more intuitive. via OpenAI News.

AI company Basata is automating tasks for doctors, but faces challenges on balancing worker support and displacement. This matters because it highlights the ongoing struggle of healthcare workers amid increasing tech pressure. via TechCrunch AI

OpenAI just launched new voice intelligence features in its API, useful for customer service and more. This will enhance user experiences across various fields like education and content creation. via TechCrunch AI
AI startup Pit, founded by Voi's co-founders, just raised $16 million in a seed round led by a16z. This highlights the growing interest in AI innovation coming out of Stockholm. via TechCrunch AI
OpenAI launched a new 'Trusted Contact' feature for ChatGPT to help users in potential self-harm situations. This aims to enhance safety and support for users in distress. via TechCrunch AI

Perplexity’s Personal Computer is now available for all Mac users, introducing AI agents to enhance productivity. This move makes advanced AI tools accessible, reshaping how we interact with technology. via TechCrunch AI

Elon Musk's lawsuit is questioning OpenAI's safety practices and its focus on benefiting humanity with AI. This could impact the future direction of AI development and accountability. via TechCrunch AI
